items.title: Najee Harris: Appears on track to start
items.text:
Harris is expected to serve as the Giants' starting running back in Sunday's game against the Saints, Jeremy Fowler of ESPN.com reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: A.J. Brown: Set to play 'good amount' of snaps Week 6
items.text:
Brown (ankle), who is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Jets, is expected to be active and play "a good amount" of snaps, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Cam Skattebo: Could be headed for lighter workload
items.text:
Skattebo had a "pretty even split in reps" this week with fellow running back Najee Harris and could be in store for fewer snaps and touches than usual in Sunday's game against the Saints, Dan Duggan of The Athletic reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Pat Freiermuth: Chance to play in Week 6
items.text:
The Steelers are "optimistic" that Freiermuth (calf) -- who is listed as questionable -- will play Sunday at Tampa Bay, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Tyler Shough: Playing through broken bones in hand
items.text:
Shough has been playing with two broken bones in his left hand, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.
